title: Scorecard computation completes in bounded time
statement: Computing a scorecard from a populated `.devai/state/sensor-readings/` directory MUST complete in under 5 seconds on the canonical adopter input (≤50 sensor kinds, ≤500 persisted readings).
rationale: Scorecard computation runs on every loop iteration and on every CI verification cycle. A runaway walk (e.g. accidentally O(n²) in cell-mapping) silently degrades the developer feedback loop. Bounding wall-clock at 5s catches regressions before they reach adopters.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
